First part: theft (盗窃) of company funds via unauthorized transfer using Alipay. That's theft (盗窃罪) maybe also "非法获取公民个人信息"? No, they used company account info, but that's theft. Also they returned money, but still theft.

Second part: forging resident identity cards. That's "伪造居民身份证件罪" (伪造、变造居民身份证件罪). Possibly also "非法获取公民个人信息"? Not.

Thus two crimes: 盗窃罪; 伪造居民身份证件罪.

Check if any other crimes: Using false ID to apply for loans maybe "贷款诈骗"? But they only forged ID to increase transfer limit and apply for small loan, but not described as loan fraud. The act of forging ID is the crime.

Thus answer list: 盗窃;伪造居民身份证件
